title: Settings
taglineHint: In a few words, explain what this site is about.
generalDesc: Site identity, URLs, language, timezone, and date/time formats.
writingDesc: Default category, editor, and optional post-via-email.
readingDesc: Homepage, blog pages, feeds, and search engine visibility.
discussionDesc: Default post comment behavior, threading, moderation, and notifications.
mediaDesc: Image size limits and upload folder organization (WordPress-style).
permalinksDesc: Select the permalink structure for your website. Including the post name makes links easier to understand and can help SEO.
privacyDesc: Privacy policy page and related options.
homeUrlHint: Usually same as Site Address unless installed in a subdirectory.
imageSizesDesc: Maximum dimensions in pixels when adding an image to the Media Library. Original file is kept; derivatives follow these sizes.
organizeUploads: Organize my uploads into month- and year-based folders
storageDriverDesc: Where uploaded media is stored. Credentials stay in .env (S3_* / R2_* / GITHUB_*) — this only picks which driver is active.
notifyLinked: Attempt to notify any blogs linked to from the post
allowPingbacks: Allow link notifications from other blogs (pingbacks and trackbacks) on new posts
allowCommentsNew: Allow people to submit comments on new posts
requireNameEmail: Comment author must fill out name and email
requireRegistration: Users must be registered and logged in to comment
closeCommentsOld: Automatically close comments on posts older than
threadDepth: Number of levels for threaded comments
commentHeldModeration: A comment is held for moderation
postsPerPage: Number of recent posts shown on archive pages
feedItems: Number of recent items shown in syndication feeds
feedInclude: For each post in a feed, include
discourageSearch: Discourage search engines from indexing this site
discourageHint: It is up to search engines to honor this request.
optionalDesc: Custom bases for category and tag URLs. Leave blank for defaults.
